name: enemy_slot_conditional_set
description: Conditional enemy-slot setter; compiled with native LTCG so the object arrives in EAX and the value on the stack (RET 4).

functions.name: EnemySlotWriter_SetEnemyIfUnmirrored
functions.actual_abi: object in EAX; stack argument; stdcall RET 4

context.description: Synthetic array-calling context that keeps the object in EAX while the candidate value is passed on the stack; not recovered game code.
